basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/SOCRadar%20Alarms%20Push/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [SOCRadar](https://socradar.io/) alarms push solution for Microsoft Sentinel lets the SOCRadar platform send alarms to Microsoft Sentinel and raises one incident per OPEN alarm. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs. a. [Codeless Connector Framework push connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-push-codeless-connector) (preview) b. [Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview) **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 10 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for SOCRadar Alarms (Push, preview). You can get SOCRadar Alarms (Push, preview) data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

link.label: Learn more about connecting data sources

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.
Alarms SOCRadar sent to Microsoft Sentinel, by status, main type and severity, new alarms per day and the latest alarms.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.
Raises one alert, and one incident, for every OPEN SOCRadar alarm of main type Executive Protection. Switch the rule off to stop incidents for that type.
